summary: Shows looping over a list of hashes and referencing subkeys like item.name and item.groups; when conditions are evaluated per item.
questions: How do I loop over a list of dictionaries in Ansible?
How do I access fields of each item in a loop?

answer_card.title: Looping over a list of hashes
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- ansible.builtin.user:
    name: "{{ item.name }}"
    groups: "{{ item.groups }}"
    state: present
  loop:
    - { name: 'testuser1', groups: 'wheel' }
    - { name: 'testuser2', groups: 'root' }
```

A `when:` on the task is evaluated per item.
